basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 6 Technologist, Technical Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Nuclear Medicine at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Nagpur is hiring 6 staff on 11-month contracts: 2 Technologists (Nuclear Medicine), 2 Technical Officers (Nuclear Medicine) and 2 Senior Technical Officers (Nuclear Medicine). The pay is consolidated, from Rs. 56,640/- to Rs. 1,08,320/- per month. The posts call for a B.Sc or an M.Sc in Nuclear Medicine Technology or an equivalent route, and the age limit is up to 40 years. content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Nagpur
content_sections.text: AIIMS Nagpur describes itself as an apex healthcare institute set up by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY). It aims to correct regional imbalances in quality tertiary-level healthcare and to make the country self-sufficient in graduate and postgraduate medical education and training. The institute is located at Plot No. 02, Sector-20, MIHAN, Nagpur – 441124.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals can apply. Qualifications are counted as on the last date of submission of the application. The age limit for every post is "Upto 40 years". Age means completed age in years as on the last date of submission of the application. Reservation is as per Government of India rules. Essential: B.Sc in Nuclear Medicine Technology from recognized university/institution. Or B.Sc in life sciences with post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine [Diploma in Medical Radio-Isotope Techniques (DMRIT)/Diploma in Nuclear Medicine Technology (DNMT)/Diploma in Fusion Imaging Technology (DFIT)]. Desirable: Experience in full-fledged Nuclear Medicine Centre having PET/CT, Gamma camera/SPECT/CT and radionuclide therapy will be preferred. Essential: M.Sc Nuclear medicine technology from recognized university/institution. 5 years of experience as Nuclear Medicine technologist (B.Sc Nuclear Medicine or equivalent + 5 years experience). Desirable: RSO level II certification. Experience in full-fledged Nuclear Medicine Centre having PET/CT, Gamma camera/SPECT/CT and radionuclide therapy will be preferred. Essential: M.Sc Nuclear Medicine Technology from recognized university/institution with 60% marks. Or M.Sc with minimum 60% marks from a recognized university/institution with post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine [Diploma in Medical Radio-Isotope Techniques (DMRIT)/Diploma in Nuclear Medicine Technology (DNMT)/Diploma in Fusion Imaging Technology (DFIT)] with minimum 50% marks. Experience required: 02 years' experience. Experience in full-fledged Nuclear Medicine Centre having PET/CT, Gamma camera/SPECT/CT and radionuclide therapy will be preferred. Desirable: RSO level II certification. PhD in Nuclear medicine specialty. The notice says the prescribed qualifications are only the minimum: having them does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview or to selection. The candidate must not have been convicted by any Court of Law. For the full discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Each post pays a consolidated monthly amount as shown in the vacancy table. The pay does not increase during the contract period. The emoluments are consolidated, as decided by the competent authority. The appointee does not get Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion or any other benefit given to regular Government servants. The appointee also cannot claim allowances or facilities given to the regular/permanent faculty of AIIMS Nagpur. If extra duties are assigned, no additional allowance is paid for them. Paid leave may be allowed at 01 day for each completed month of service. The appointment is purely on contract for 11 (Eleven) Months, counted from the date of joining. It ends earlier if regular appointments are made against these posts or another arrangement is made. The contract may be extended, depending on the institute's needs and satisfactory performance. If it is not extended, it lapses automatically. The job cannot be regularized at any stage, and the appointee has no claim or right to regular appointment to any post of AIIMS Nagpur. Either side can end the appointment at any time with one month's notice or one month's salary. It can also be ended if the appointee fails to complete the first three months to the satisfaction of the competent authority. The competent authority can also terminate it before the end of the tenure without giving a reason. The appointment is whole-time. The appointee cannot take any other assignment, paid or unpaid, and private practice of any kind is prohibited. An appointee who applies elsewhere or resigns within the first 03 (three) months will not get a No Objection Certificate, a Relieving Letter or an Experience Certificate. Appointment depends on medical fitness, certified by the competent medical board. On appointment, the appointee must take an oath of allegiance to the Constitution of India or make a solemn affirmation. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview or written test, or for joining.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form from the AIIMS Nagpur website (aiimsnagpur.edu.in). If you are a General/OBC/EWS candidate, pay the non-refundable fee of Rs. 1,000/- by NEFT into the bank account below. PwBD/SC/ST candidates are exempted from the fee. Fill in the application form and attach self-attested copies of all relevant certificates, testimonials and other documents. Send the application, the copy of the payment receipt and the certificate copies through the Google form (forms.gle/6YFqwBs9umvivtgs5). Make sure the application reaches AIIMS Nagpur by 05:00 PM on 10 November 2026. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Documents named in the notice: Application in the prescribed format Copy of the fee payment receipt (also "may bring" it to the interview) Self-attested copies of all relevant certificates/testimonials and other relevant documents All relevant original documents, for verification before the interview No Objection Certificate at the time of interview, for candidates working in Central/State Government, Semi Government or an Autonomous body (without it, the candidature may be rejected) For help or clarification, email [email protected] and put the name of the post you applied for in the subject line, or call 07103-295590.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is based on shortlisting, scrutiny of applications with document verification, and an interview. If a large number of applications is received, a screening test may be held to shortlist candidates for interview. Shortlisting: Candidates are shortlisted for interview on the basis of educational qualification, relevant experience and/or shortlisting criteria decided by the Executive Director, AIIMS Nagpur. Scrutiny and document verification: Before the interview, a duly constituted committee checks each application and verifies documents for qualification, experience, category, age and so on. Only candidates declared eligible after this check can appear for the interview. Interview: The interview will be held at AIIMS Nagpur, or at another place and in another mode if the Executive Director decides so. Candidates must score the minimum qualifying marks (suitability standard) set by the Selection Committee to be placed on the merit panel. Candidates below this standard will not be selected, whatever their merit position. Appearing for the interview does not give anyone a right to selection. The notice says this selection procedure is indicative and may be changed at the discretion of the Executive Director, AIIMS Nagpur. The decision of the Competent Authority on selection is final, and no representations will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates who do not meet the eligibility criteria on the first cut-off date but become eligible by a later cut-off date can follow the institute's website for remaining vacancies and new cut-off dates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 vacancies: 2 for Technologist (Nuclear Medicine), 2 for Technical Officer (Nuclear Medicine) and 2 for Senior Technical Officer (Nuclear Medicine), all in the UR category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Nagpur Nuclear Medicine posts?
faq.answer: The first cut-off date is 10 November 2026. Applications must reach AIIMS Nagpur through the Google form by 05:00 PM on that day. Cut-off dates for any unfilled vacancies will be notified on the institute's website.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Technologist (Nuclear Medicine) post?
faq.answer: You need a B.Sc in Nuclear Medicine Technology from a recognized university/institution. The alternative is a B.Sc in life sciences with a post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine (DMRIT/DNMT/DFIT).

faq.question: Q4. What is the eligibility for Senior Technical Officer (Nuclear Medicine)?
faq.answer: You need an M.Sc Nuclear Medicine Technology with 60% marks, or an M.Sc with minimum 60% marks plus a post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine (DMRIT/DNMT/DFIT) with minimum 50% marks. You also need 02 years' experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is "Upto 40 years" for all three posts. Age is counted as completed years on the last date of submission of the application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the AIIMS Nagpur Nuclear Medicine posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is Rs. 56,640/- per month for Technologist, Rs. 89,760/- for Technical Officer and Rs. 1,08,320/- for Senior Technical Officer. The pay does not increase during the contract period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General/OBC/EWS candidates pay a non-refundable fee of Rs. 1,000/- by NEFT to the AIIMS EXAM FEE account at Bank of Baroda, AIIMS Nagpur Campus. PwBD/SC/ST candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q8. How is the selection done for these AIIMS Nagpur posts?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted on qualification, relevant experience and/or criteria set by the Executive Director, and a screening test may be held if many apply. After application scrutiny and document verification, eligible candidates are interviewed and must reach the minimum qualifying standard.

faq.question: Q9. Is the AIIMS Nagpur Nuclear Medicine job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely on contract for 11 (Eleven) Months and cannot be regularized at any stage. It may be extended depending on the institute's needs and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q10. Do government employees need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates working in Central/State Government, Semi Government or an Autonomous body must submit a No Objection Certificate from their organisation at the time of interview. Without it, the candidature may be rejected.
